# SheetJS Community Edition

Pinned version: 0.20.3. Downloaded from the official distribution:
https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/package/dist/xlsx.full.min.js

SHA256: cc015130aa8521e7f088f88898eba949ccdcbfb38df0bd129b44b7273c3a6f41

The accompanying SheetJS-LICENSE.txt is the upstream license. The library is
served locally and lazily; spreadsheet imports execute in a disposable worker.

# ExcelJS

Pinned version: 4.4.0. Browser bundle from the official `exceljs` npm package
(`dist/exceljs.min.js`), loaded only when exporting attendance to Excel so
cancelled lecture headings can have red text without colouring the cell.
The accompanying `ExcelJS-LICENSE.txt` is the upstream MIT license.
